create.name: Lori Sheridan
create.bio:
Lori Sheridan, who also writes as Lori Doupé Sheridan, is an evidential psychic medium and spiritual teacher based in Norwell, Massachusetts, on the South Shore below Boston. She is certified as a medium by the Forever Family Foundation, was ordained as a Spiritualist minister through The Journey Within church in New Jersey, and has trained at the Arthur Findlay College in England as well as with American teachers. Her private readings, given at her Norwell studio, Hope Ethereal, or over Zoom, centre on messages from loved ones in spirit and on intuitive guidance for the questions people bring.

Much of her work goes into helping others develop their own sensitivity. She runs small online mentorship groups for newer and more experienced mediums, short courses through The Journey Within and day workshops in Norwell, and she teaches at Lily Dale in New York and gives public evenings of spirit messages across New England. Her 2025 book, Soul Compass, offers stories and exercises for learning to rely on inner guidance, and she has made a companion oracle deck. At Esalen she joins the author William Donius to teach a weekend on intuition and spirit guides.

books.title: Soul Compass: Trusting Your Intuition and the Wisdom Within
books.author: Lori Doupé Sheridan
books.description: A practical guide to recognising and trusting intuition, published by Inner Peace Press in 2025. Personal stories from her work as a medium sit alongside step-by-step exercises for building a clearer sense of inner guidance and connection with spirit.

courses.title: Unlock Your Intuitive Mind: Tap Into Your Higher Consciousness
courses.description: A weekend at Esalen in Big Sur led by William Donius with Lori as guest faculty, with an optional third night. His writing-based exercises for reaching fresh insight are paired with her sessions on how intuition speaks and on working with spirit guides.

courses.title: Spirit Whisperer Mentorship
courses.description: Five live two-hour Zoom sessions for beginner and intermediate students of mediumship, spread from February to June 2027. Small-group teaching, guided practice and partner exercises help students sense spirit communication and give evidence with confidence. Places are limited and subject to her approval.

courses.title: Advanced Mediumship Techniques
courses.description: A three-week online class run through The Journey Within for intermediate and advanced mediums, on Wednesday evenings in December. Exercises and feedback focus on deepening the link with spirit and letting the evidence unfold.

courses.title: Soul Potential Workshop
courses.description: A one-day New Year workshop at her Norwell studio for up to 16 people. The day mixes spirit connection, reflection and intention-setting as each person draws up a personal plan for the year ahead; higher ticket tiers add her oracle deck and book.

courses.title: Private Psychic and Mediumship Reading
courses.description: A 30-minute one-to-one reading in Norwell or over Zoom, offering evidential mediumship, intuitive guidance or a mix of the two. A one-hour extended reading is also available for $450 USD.
